title: Factors for Visual Acuity Improvement After Anti-VEGF Treatment of Wet Age-Related Macular Degeneration in China: 12 Months Follow up

groups.description: Typical choroidal neovascularization subtype of untreated wet AMD (baseline angiography), retrospective two-centre cohort (Guangdong, May 2014 to April 2018); 3+PRN advised, injections in practice limited by economic factors.
Polypoidal choroidal vasculopathy subtype (namd) of the same cohort.
Eyes of the same cohort treated with conbercept.
Eyes of the same cohort treated with ranibizumab.

decision: excluded: no admissible series (inclusion required completed follow-up data and at least 1 year of follow-up, equal to the last tabulated visit, and eyes with surgery during follow-up were removed from every visit)

exclusions.what: Table 3 (T3) BCVA (ETDRS letters) baseline means and mean changes at months 1, 2, 3, 6 and 12 for ALL, CNV, PCV, conbercept and ranibizumab
exclusions.reason: complete-case set and post-baseline selection: inclusion required completed follow-up data and a follow-up of at least 1 year after the first injection, equal to the last tabulated visit (month 12), with no statement that no treated eye was left out; patients with any ocular surgery during follow-up (cataract, glaucoma, vitreoretinal, laser, YAG capsulotomy) were excluded from every visit (protocol inclusion 5; brief complete-case and post-baseline rulings)

exclusions.what: Table 3 medians (IQR), ranges and P columns
exclusions.reason: medians, ranges and p-values are not admissible

exclusions.what: Table 5 (T5) univariate and multivariate analyses and Figure 2
BCVA changes quoted in the Results text and proportions reaching a 5-letter gain
exclusions.reason: text values of the same excluded sets; proportions are not admissible

notes: BCVA was measured with a Snellen chart and converted per eye to approximate ETDRS letter scores for the analysis (Methods); such series would be stored as printed letters with a note, but the analysis sets are complete-case.
PCV is recorded as a namd subtype.
Central retinal thickness (Table 4) and injection counts (Table 2) are reported in the article and mentioned here only.
No record is written: the study has no admissible series under extraction protocol 1.0.0 and the extraction brief.
